info.title: Signet Registry API
info.description: Programmatic management plane for the Signet agent/skill registry: lifecycle, certification, transparency, provenance, and time-aware operations.

200.description: API key rotated (new secret returned once)

404.description: API key not found or revoked

200.description: Get agent version provenance: structured view by default; PROV-O JSON-LD document with ?format=jsonld (derived from the same canonical triple list)
Provenance signature attached (shape: { provenance_signature, created }; identical re-attach returns the existing record)

409.description: Stale digest, untrusted key, invalid signature, or conflicting duplicate

200.description: Report signature attached (shape: { report_signature, created }; identical re-attach returns the existing record)

409.description: Invalid target report, untrusted key, invalid signature, or conflicting duplicate

200.description: Agent version revalidated (recorded outcome; lifecycle status unchanged)

Read-only corpus analysis of capability claims against resolved skill-area ontologies
